blocks.text: Yelanon Furniture Moving Sliders effortlessly glide heavy furniture across hardwood, tile, and carpet. Protect your floors from scratches and dents while easily rearranging sofas, tables, or cabinets. Durable, reusable, and designed for a smooth, quiet move. Simplify your home maintenance with our reliable slider set.

items.label: MOVE YOUR HEAVY FURNITURE EASILY & SAFELY
items.value: Furniture Sliders for carpet, Yelanon protect the floors from scratches while moving the furniture! SAVE YOUR FURNITURE AND FLOORS with furniture moving pads. No extra effort required, easy to move the item.

items: FURNITURE MOVING PADS PROTECT ALL CARPET SURFACES - 20 pcs 3 1/2” beige square furniture sliders for carpet. Just put these rubber foam under the furniture feet to move it, no more scratches and noise here!

items.label: THICK DESIGN AND MULTIPURPOSE
items.value: The 2/5” thick perfect for both round & square FURNITURE LEGS WITH A DIAMETER OF 3 1/2” and provide lasting protection with bottom Felt pad. IT CAN BE USED ON: table, dresser, couch, piano, recliner, sofa, bed, and other heavy furniture on all type carpets and quickly and easily move them!

items: HIGH MATERIAL & DURABLE – Yelanon furniture sliders for hardwood floors made of plastic with rubber foam.No glue need to stick and won’t stain your furniture legs and the furniture sliders provides excellent weight distribution. Reusable sliders can help you move heavy item with little effort!
YELANON IS A REGISTERED TRADEMARK - We take pride in providing the highest quality and most durable Furniture Sliders on the market . We are happy to guarantee our product.
